name: Barcode Scanner

width.label: Clear width (m)
width.desc: The gap between the two columns, across the direction of travel. Wider than the conveyor, so the columns stand clear of its legs.

surfaceHeight.label: Conveyor height (m)
surfaceHeight.desc: Height of the conveying surface under the arch: the bottom of the read zone.

clearance.label: Clearance (m)
clearance.desc: From the conveying surface up to the scanner head. The tallest load must pass under it; the read zone fills that height.

readDepth.label: Read depth (m)
readDepth.desc: How far along the direction of travel (local Z) the read window reaches, centred under the head. A case is read as it crosses the scan line once its CENTRE is in the window, and the scan window lights while one is.

codeMark.label: Code attribute
codeMark.desc: The product attribute the label carries, read off each case into the code tag: a number, or digits in text. A case without it reads 0.

showBeam.label: Show scan line
showBeam.desc: Draw the scan line across the conveyor. A viewing aid only.

beamColor.label: Beam color
beamColor.desc: Paint of the crossbeam the head hangs from.

readTag.label: Good read tag (pulse)
readTag.desc: Goes true for a quarter of a second each time a case is read. Take its rising edge to count or to act on a read.

countTag.label: Read count tag
countTag.desc: Running total of cases read this run. It only ever climbs.

codeTag.label: Code tag (the last code read)
codeTag.desc: The code on the label of the last case read, set on the same scan the good-read pulse rises. It holds until the next read.
